pages.text: Three races of StarCraft II have come to this world: the $(l)Zerg$(), the $(l)Terrans$() and the $(l)Protoss$(). Their main bases lie about 480 blocks from where you first appeared.$(br2)Wild units are foes to every player; units of your own fight for you.

Three ways to play, mixed as you like:$(li)spawn eggs: a unit you place is yours;$(li)a supply platform, in survival;$(li)the command view ($(k:key.starmine.command)) and taking control of one of your units.
